themes.label: Unregulated AI among global threats
themes.definition: Unregulated AI named briefly alongside climate, pandemics and other crises as threats that a rules-based system must help face.
themes.inclusion: Include passages listing 'unregulated AI' among global challenges without further elaboration.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that detail specific AI harms or governance proposals.
themes.boundary_cases: A list item that adds a promise/risk qualifier is also coded AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY.

examples.quote: to allow us to better face challenges from climate to pandemics to unregulated AI

themes.label: Tremendous promise, significant unregulated risk
themes.definition: Brief framing of unregulated AI as holding tremendous promise but posing significant risk.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit promise-and-risk statements about AI, even when brief.
themes.exclusion: Exclude bare list mentions with no promise/risk framing.
themes.boundary_cases: Where the risk is tied to lack of regulation, also consider AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE if rules are demanded for AI specifically.

examples.quote: unregulated AI, which while it has tremendous promise, poses unregulated significant risk

value.rationale: Both Barbados passages mention unregulated AI only briefly within a list of threats justifying a rules-based order; one adds a promise-versus-risk qualifier.
